name: AXM Tycoon Steward Layer
summary: Steer a seeded region through broad zones, products and policy; capture a genuinely emerged district as causal memory, then guide other zones toward that pattern in Preserve or Evolve mode without cloning buildings or bypassing costs.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL local test candidate with an original warm-island palace presentation. Not installed, not promoted, not canon, and not integrated with the living globe. Opens without a runtime network dependency; browser storage and downloads occur only after visible user actions. The GlobeAdapter is disconnected and proposal-only, with no live host mutation method.
